claimsChecked: Published v0.11.0 Git relay lacks Basic challenge; pinned runner adds it.
Published application image intentionally lacks npm/npx/Corepack, while fresh OpenCode bootstrap requires npm for its pinned runtime and plugin even for dependency-free project.
Reference Compose chooses MINDDY_IMAGE for worker image; dedicated worker override is required, not implied by helper mounts.
Persistent helper pair, read-only mounts, no published runner port, reapply after historical installer/update and preserve matching backup/restore override paths.

Cold backup seals helper files and hashes alongside protected configuration; physical restore uses absent target directory, validates saved hashes and includes runner override in every Compose command.
H03 inline dedicated worker Dockerfile exactly matches candidate source: pinned Node24 base, npm retained, Git/CA, UID10001 and no runner host exposure.
Worker recipe resolves Debian packages at build time; record and archive exact Docker image ID, preserve Dockerfile/reference/image tar and load+inspect matching image before restoration startup.
Real Compose service environment overlay overrides historical hard-coded sandbox choice; standalone protected-file environment alone is insufficient.
compose up, rather than final health command, is the runner-only recreation operation.
Explicit exec is required on /vercel tmpfs for native OpenCode bootstrap; read-only root filesystem, UID10001, capability drop, no-new-privileges, nosuid/nodev and 0700 tmpfs isolation remain.
H03 sets up with --skip-start, then applies pinned helper/storage/functions adaptations and dedicated worker before explicit Compose startup; contradictory historical rerun instructions are removed.
H03 private bootstrap wrapper uses exported historical configuration functions, protected environment and 0600 log, stops on failure, and does not expose configuration values in article output.

Published v0.11.0 installer/bootstrap reject --encryption, while its runtime recognizes the flag and the reference application service DOES load the protected file through env_file. Changed effective configuration requires service recreation, matching schema and actual behavior verification; a generated root key is insufficient proof.
